name: @repo/repo-guards
description: Derived fitness tests over the repo ITSELF: the invariants that span workspaces and therefore belong to none of them — the package dependency DAG and its platform-purity rules, ws change-kind reachability, the app's turbo env passthrough, and vendored-code provenance.
